defense_news.title: New human-machine interface will help Boxer punch above its weight
defense_news.summary: An Australian startup has teamed with Rheinmetall to enable soldiers to direct nearby drones with voice commands from aboard Boxer vehicles.

defense_news.title: Lockheed invests $300M in Texas plant to feed missile surge
defense_news.summary: Lockheed is investing $300 million to expand its Grand Prairie, Texas, plant, which supports all programs within its Missiles and Fire Control business.

defense_news.title: Killer balloons an option as US Army seeks to ‘exploit the stratosphere’
defense_news.summary: While using balloons as shooters likely presents more challenges than using them for sensing, nothing is off the table, an Army official said.

defense_news.title: Ukrainian officials blame Pentagon for withholding life-saving intel from Kyiv
defense_news.summary: The U.S. appears to have stopped sharing some forms of key intelligence with Kyiv, Ukrainian officials said Wednesday.

geo_news.title: İstanbul sonbaharın ilk iki ayında aldığı yağıştan fazlasını iki günde gördü
geo_news.summary: İstanbul genelinde 13-15 Ekim arasındaki 48 saatte metrekareye düşen yağış miktarı, eylül-ekim aylarının uzun dönem ortalamasını geçti.
